script.greeting: Hello. This is a call from {org_name} regarding an outstanding payment.
script.prompt: A payment of {amount} is due on {due_date}. Press one if you will make the payment, two if you need more time.
script.reprompt: Please press one if you will pay or two if you need more time.
script.ack_confirm: Thank you. We look forward to receiving your payment.
script.ack_decline: Thank you for letting us know.
script.ack_reschedule: Thank you. We will follow up.
script.ack_call_later: Thank you. We will call you again later.
script.ack_stop: Understood. We will not call you again.
script.ack_unclear: Sorry, we could not record your response. We may try again later.
script.voicemail: Hello, this is {org_name}. A payment of {amount} is due on {due_date}. Please contact us.
